name: Con Dao
blurb: Con Dao can be reached by boat or flight rather than roads, with new high-speed boat routes and resumed flight services connecting to the islands. Online conversation is currently quiet as administrative changes designate the islands as a special commune.

positive: Praised for conservation efforts and IUCN Green List status for the National Park
Noted as an underrated destination with unspoiled nature
Appreciated for retaining its character over years without dramatic tourism damage
negative: Communication can be hit or miss due to language barriers
Historical prison sites feature creepy displays with fake figures in shackles
Travel requires planning as there are no roads, trains, or buses directly to it

quotes.text:
